findings.body:
**Use the title cache only for items that have a PR number.**

The cache at status_summary.py:353 uses `(repo, pr)` as its key. Backfill, coverage and local-review previews usually have `pr=None`, so every PR-less row in one repo shares the key `(repo, None)`. The last such row in the prior summary decides the cached value. At status_summary.py:358, a new PR-less item with no `title` then gets the title of a different item. That puts a wrong label in the published preview.

Store and look up cached titles only when `pr` is a positive `int`. That is the same guard the `gh api` fallback already uses at status_summary.py:359.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-        titles = {(i["repo"], i["pr"]): i.get("title") for i in read(target).get("pending_items", [])}
+        titles = {(i["repo"], i["pr"]): i.get("title") for i in read(target).get("pending_items", [])
+                  if type(i.get("pr")) is int and i["pr"] > 0}
     except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
         titles = {}
     for item in data["pending_items"]:
         repo, pr = item["repo"], item["pr"]
-        item["title"] = item["title"] or titles.get((repo, pr))
+        if type(pr) is int and pr > 0:
+            item["title"] = item["title"] or titles.get((repo, pr))
```
</details>
findings.title: Use the title cache only for items that have a PR number.

findings.body:
**Commit receipt totals after processing all paths.**

In `apps/crq-python/status_summary.py:114`, a `done` or `unsupported` receipt can have a non-dict path entry or an unhashable disposition. The path loop then raises after the category count increases, so the receipt also counts as `unverified`. Earlier paths and the target can also remain in the summary.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-            counts[category] += 1
-            targets.add(capture["target"])
+            receipt_exclusions = exclusions.copy()
             for path in capture["paths"]:
                 disposition = path.get("disposition", "unknown")
                 if disposition not in ("included", "renamed"):
-                    exclusions[disposition] = exclusions.get(disposition, 0) + 1
+                    receipt_exclusions[disposition] = receipt_exclusions.get(disposition, 0) + 1
+            counts[category] += 1
+            targets.add(capture["target"])
+            exclusions = receipt_exclusions
```

</details>
findings.title: Commit receipt totals after processing all paths.
